prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of thick sandstone walls seen from above: big weathered sandstone blocks with sand on top The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless repeating ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: overhead surface of thick sandstone walls, large weathered sandstone masonry blocks with patches of settled sand on top and in irregular joints. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, hand-placed uniform crisp square pixels, consistent pixel grid, clusters of 3–10 art pixels with clear deliberate silhouettes. No antialiasing, blur, gradients, noise, photographic texture, or dithering. Warm earthy sandstone with 4–6 distinct shades per material, hue-shifted warm yellow highlights and richer muted purple-red shadows. Orthographic straight-down/steep classic JRPG map camera, no perspective convergence. Neutral even soft upper-left ambient lighting; clean base colors, no cast shadows, glow, vignette, darkness, or local light sources. Tileable on BOTH axes: stone outlines, sand patches, and colors continue seamlessly across left/right and top/bottom boundaries. Fill entire image edge to edge with surface, evenly distributed block-and-sand detail, no border, frame, objects, characters, lettering, or focal point. Square texture.
